description: Every update lands in one pull request on Monday morning; a fix for a known vulnerability comes at once in a pull request of its own. Actions and images are pinned by digest, and a tool's checksum moves with its version.

packageRules.description: Cluster API pins the controller-runtime and Kubernetes minor it is built and tested against; those move with Cluster API, not on their own.
conversion-gen follows the Kubernetes minor go.mod builds against.
A new minor of Kubernetes, etcd, CoreDNS or Flannel in the integration tests' cluster needs a Talos release that runs it, so it comes in a pull request of its own and does not hold back the rest.

customManagers.description: A version named in a comment on the line above it: the tools the Makefile installs, talosctl, and the Go hack/install-go.sh installs.
The Talos node image of the integration tests' cluster, named by version and digest.
The manifests the integration tests install with clusterctl, named by release URL and checked against their SHA-256.
Every image the integration tests' cluster pulls, named by tag and digest: in the Talos configuration patches and in components.txt.
The image ko builds the controller on, named by a tag that is no version, so only its digest moves.
